title: A fact table used as a filter argument filters the dimensions it is related to

source.quote: the filter context contains all the columns of the expanded version of Sales
source.supports: the article's NumOfProductsSold = CALCULATE ( [NumOfProducts], Sales ) counts only products with sales, because the filter is the expanded Sales table

derivation: Sales as a filter is its expanded table, which includes the Product columns. The products appearing in Sales are 1 (Bike), 2 (Helmet), 3 (Lock). Scooter has no sales, so 3 of the 4 products remain.
